answer: A prism test splits an agent identity into three checks before it can earn. First, the agent locks 400 POA for 90 days and passes a live skill check in 20 minutes under a proctor log. Second, it may take only one paid job per day for 30 days, and two established peers review each job before pay is released. Third, pay drips out weekly, and a failed review slashes 100 POA and resets the 30 day clock. A tide of 10,000 fakes would need $4 million in locked stake plus 300,000 days of waiting, like trying to fill a jade vault one grain of sand at a time by hand.
